documents.title: Presentation - Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors on October 29, 2026
Recording - Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors on October 29, 2026
Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results, Limited Review Report for September 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Wheels India presented its Q1 FY27 investor presentation, reporting standalone gross revenue of Rs 1,386.07 crore and consolidated gross revenue of Rs 1,492.79 crore. The company estimated its FY27 capex to be in the range of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crore. Strategic focus areas include growing export volumes for construction equipment and agricultural tractor wheels, expanding windmill component production, and growing the hydraulic cylinder and cast aluminium wheel businesses. Management plans to fund capex predominantly through internal accruals while maintaining debt at current levels. Management reported a strong operational and financial performance for Q4 and full year FY26, crossing INR 5,000 crores in annual turnover for the first time with a 16% growth over the previous year.

capex_expansion.claim: FY27 capex is estimated to be between Rs 400 crore and Rs 450 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent about INR 261 crores towards capex last year across the windmill business, aluminium business, off-road businesses, and routine capex.
capex_expansion.quote: In terms of capex, last year, we basically spent about INR261 crores towards capex, which is both in terms of investment towards the windmill business, aluminium business and a little bit of the off-road businesses and some routine capex and cost savings totalling INR261 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects the capex for the current year to be between INR 280 crores and INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And we expect in the current year, it will be between INR280 crores to INR300 crores of capex.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex of FY26 is mainly towards expanding capacity for machining of large castings, windmill products, automotive aluminium & steel wheels, Earth mover and Big agri wheels apart from certain routine capex and cost saving projects.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex of FY26 is mainly towards expanding capacity for machining of large castings, windmill products, automotive aluminium & steel wheels, Earth mover and Big agri wheels apart from certain routine capex and cost saving projects.

margins_costs.claim: The company is focusing on cost optimization with an emphasis on profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Cost optimization, with a thrust on profitability

margins_costs.claim: For the whole year, the net forex gain was close to INR 10 crores.
margins_costs.quote: And for the whole year, it is about close to INR10 crores as forex gain.

margins_costs.claim: Cost optimization has a thrust on profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Cost optimization, with a thrust on profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The combined steel wheel capacity for passenger cars between Wheels India and its subsidiary is about 11 million to 12 million.
orders_capacity.quote: So if you take passenger car, steel wheels between us and our subsidiary, if I look at it combined, I think Wheels India has got a capacity of about 4 million and the subsidiary has got a capacity of about 7 million. So about 11 million to 12 million is the capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The aluminium wheel capacity is currently about 42,000 per month and will increase to 60,000 in a few months, and then to 80,000 by the half year.
orders_capacity.quote: In aluminium wheels we currently have a capacity of about 42,000 per month. We are increasing it -- in a few months we are increasing it to 60,000 and then by half year, we'll increase it to 80,000.
